rules.title: Good cause required to refuse lease renewal (Anti-Eviction Act)
rules.requirement: Landlords of residential rental properties may not fail to renew a written or oral lease unless they have good cause; the good causes are those listed in the eviction section of the guide.
rules.coverage_text: Residential rental properties, except owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings, motels or hotels, and transient or seasonal units.

exemption_tests.description: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings are excepted (covered by separate provisions).
Motels or hotels, transient, or seasonal units are excepted.

rules.exemptions_text: Owner occupied two or three family dwellings, motels or hotels, transient, or seasonal units.
rules.quoted_span: No landlord of residential rental properties except t hose in owner occupied two or three family dwellings, motels or hotels, transient, or seasonal units may fail to renew any lease, regardless of whether it is written or oral unless they have good cause not to renew the lease.
rules.ambiguity_note: Informational guide summarizing the statute; citation appears as written in the guide.
